title: 2 Hour Private Tiki Boat Cruises in Virginia Beach
blurb: Cruise the stunning Lynnhaven Inlet on a private tiki boat with Hampton Roads Boat Company, perfect for up to 6 guests. Whether you're celebrating a birthday, bachelorette party, or just enjoying a sunset with friends, our customized tours promise unforgettable moments. With options like half day charters and sunset cruises, your adventure is tailored to your vibe. Enjoy the coastline, relax with your crew, and make memories that last a lifetime.
